packs.name: IDOR / BOLA Boundary Check
packs.purpose: Low-noise candidate check for object-boundary mismatches after MCP or scanner context already identified the route family.
packs.best_when: A scanner issue, proxy history cluster, or MCP issue context already points at one object family.
packs.stop_when: One clean role-separated object diff is captured in Repeater.

packs.name: Stored XSS Viewer Path Check
packs.purpose: Separate storage-path candidates from later viewer-path proof so the operator can build a clean evidence chain.
packs.best_when: A comment, post, profile, note, or feedback workflow is already in scope and the bridge has marked a likely storage sink.
packs.stop_when: One viewer path and one render proof are paired to the same stored marker.

packs.name: SSRF Callback Check
packs.purpose: Bounded out-of-band callback confirmation for request families that already look like fetch sinks.
packs.best_when: MCP or scanner context already points at a URL-like parameter, webhook field, proxy field, or callback sink.
packs.stop_when: One exact request variant produces one correlatable Collaborator interaction.

packs.name: Auth Boundary Check
packs.purpose: Flag privileged-route candidates so the operator can compare lower-privilege, expired, and logged-out states on one route family.
packs.best_when: The target has admin, internal, moderation, management, or export-style routes that are already reachable in normal browsing.
packs.stop_when: One denied baseline and one stronger unauthorized access proof are captured.

packs.name: CSRF State Change Check
packs.purpose: Highlight likely state-changing requests that lack obvious anti-CSRF markers before the operator performs one bounded forgery comparison.
packs.best_when: The workflow already has a low-risk state change to compare and MCP history shows the request family clearly.
packs.stop_when: One low-risk forged state change or one control that blocks it is documented.
packs.recommended_burp_feature: Repeater with Origin and token comparison

packs.name: Mass Assignment Field Check
packs.purpose: Flag workflow-significant JSON fields so the operator can test one bounded extra-field mutation instead of broad guessing.
packs.best_when: JSON APIs accept role, tenant, pricing, approval, ownership, or status fields from the client.
packs.stop_when: One server-managed field is accepted, persisted, or honored beyond baseline.
packs.recommended_burp_feature: Repeater plus JSON field extraction Bambda

packs.name: Business Logic Invariant Check
packs.purpose: Mark request families with pricing, inventory, approval, or quota invariants so the operator can test one business rule change at a time.
packs.best_when: The workflow includes money, credits, limits, stock, approvals, or ordering rules.
packs.stop_when: One invariant break with a clear business effect is confirmed.
